creator: Alexander Terp
description:
ParseFile is documented for tooling that only reads files - editors, migration
scripts. It calls schema(), which rejects a Suite with a nil Run, so every
read-only caller has to stub a runner it will never invoke.

Friction aimed squarely at the audience the function was written for. Split the
Run check out of schema validation for the parse-only path.
title: ParseFile demands a Suite.Run it never calls
